title: Cultural Analytics for Good: Building Inclusive Evaluation Frameworks for Historical IR
reasoning: The paper focuses on building an Information Retrieval (IR) benchmark for historical archives to improve cultural access. While the dataset includes topics such as 'Spiritualism and séances', 'Slavery and freedom', and 'Fallen women', and mentions the 'ethical dimensions' of information access, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, faith, or ethics themselves, but rather the technical performance of retrieval models on these historical subjects.
